title: Commonwealth Gas Company files for approval and review of an agreement for squasi-firm transportation service with W.R. Grace & Company and a revised Appendix A with Perkit Folding Box Corporation.
filings: Approval of the quasi-form transportation service agreement with W.R. Grace & Company and of a revised Appendix A to the agreement for quasi-firm transportation with Perkit Folding Box Corporation. Signed by: John B. Howe, Chairman; and Janet Gail Besser, Commissioner.
